title: Sandbox Report
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of sandbox-runner. Emits a smoke-test script and records the outcome once the script is externally executed. Because fenced agents cannot run Bash/GPU, smoke_passed is nullable and defaults to null until a real server runs the script. The report is valid before external execution — it records the script and invocation command for the out-of-band step.

condition_id.description: The experiment condition this smoke test targets.

from_implementation_ref.description: Reference to the implementation_record being smoke-tested.

smoke_script.description: The actual runnable smoke-test script (code, not prose). Emitted as an artifact for out-of-band execution on a real server.

invoke_command.description: Shell command to execute the smoke_script (e.g. 'python smoke_test.py').

smoke_passed.description: Null until the script is externally executed. True = passed, False = failed. Fenced agents cannot set this — it is filled by an out-of-band runner.

exit_code.description: Exit code from the external run. Null until executed.

stdout_tail.description: Last N lines of stdout from the external run. Null until executed.

stderr_tail.description: Last N lines of stderr from the external run. Null until executed.

notes.description: Any notes on what the script tests, known limitations, or expected output.
